Ethanol and ethanoic acid react to form ethyl ethanoate and water.
CH3CH2OH+CH3CO2H⇌CH3CO2CH2CH3+H2O
Which statement explains why concentrated sulfuric acid is added to the reaction mixture?
A
The position of equilibrium moves to the left-hand side.
B
Sulfuric acid is a weaker acid than ethanoic acid.
C
The total frequency of collisions decreases.
D
Sulfuric acid acts as a catalyst for the reaction.

options.label: A
options.text: The position of equilibrium moves to the left-hand side.

options.label: B
options.text: Sulfuric acid is a weaker acid than ethanoic acid.

options.label: C
options.text: The total frequency of collisions decreases.

options.label: D
options.text: Sulfuric acid acts as a catalyst for the reaction.
